description: Reference multi-tier model mapping for Mac Mini M5 Pro / Apple Silicon with 64GB Unified Memory

rationale.Researcher_Formalist_Engineer_Auditor: Unified 26B-A4B MoE model (3.8B active / 25.2B total, GGUF llama-server, ~27.6 GB wired with OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0 + OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1) powers all four text specialists (@Researcher, @Formalist, @Engineer, @Auditor) at ~52-55 tok/s with zero specialist stage-swap eviction or representation drift.
rationale.Facet_Orchestrator_Scribe: E4B pairs 4.5B effective PLE parameters with a dedicated ~150M Vision Encoder at T=0.1, top_p=0.95, top_k=64 for transient read-only hypervisor seal gating (@Facet), sub-second task routing (@Orchestrator), and upstream Stage 0V PDF/diagram OCR (@Scribe) with zero VRAM swap across all three roles.
rationale.SystemOneDecider: Boundary-only System-1 decision model (pplx-decider-flash, 4B multimodal Vision+Text, 256K ctx, keep_alive=0 under strict OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1) executes <1 s zero-output-token semantic spec checks, Stage 4 diagnosis-vs-label overrides, and Method L3 AST/JSON hunk mass-pooling edit-scope localization while leaving 0 B in VRAM.
